name: grad-business-pack
description: 31 Claude Skills for doing the work a business graduate is hired for, checking every output, and showing it to employers: an AI delegation map, a Claude Project setup, task briefs, output checks and AI use statements; company research briefs, PESTLE, SWOT and a weekly commercial awareness habit; issue trees, spreadsheet explainers, data analysis walkthroughs, simple financial models and sanity checks; executive summaries, emails to senior stakeholders, business cases and weekly status updates; deck storylines, chart choices, slide builds and deck reviews; a proof project brief, an AI work log, a portfolio case study and a reflection; plus job ad decoding, CV evidence lines, AI interview answers, an application voice check and assessment centre case practice. For business, management, accounting, finance and economics graduates, final-year students, business analysts and management trainees. Each skill is one named method or one artifact, with the inputs it needs, where it breaks, a fixed output template and the next skill to run.
